question: {If } 30\% { of } 50\% { of } (4)/(7) { of a number is } 303, { find the number.}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

30% × 50% × 4/7 = (3/10 × 1/2 × 4/7)

= 6/70 = 3/35

So 3/35 of number = 303

Number = 303 × 35 ÷ 3 = 3535

**∴ Answer = 3535**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

30% of 50% of 4/7 of a number = 303

**Formula used:**

Percentage × Fraction × Number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ 30% × 50% × 4/7 × x = 303

⇒ (3/10 × 1/2 × 4/7) × x = 303

⇒ (12/140) × x = 303

⇒ (3/35) × x = 303

⇒ x = 303 × 35 ÷ 3

⇒ x = 3535

**∴ The correct answer is 3535.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

30% = 3/10, 50% = 1/2

Multiplication Rule

Successive percentages multiply together.

Reverse Calculation

If a fraction of number is known, divide to get original number.
